text:
Mira: Quick sync after the PM — we have recurring eviction/queue-growth incidents. Need a compact follow-up plan: runbook edits, quick detection, and owner assignments. Who can pick what?
Tony: I'll own the runbook edits. Focusing on concise triage bullets + a 'fast rollback' section. Will add a tiny command set and where to find logs. ETA: Thu EOD.
Eva: I'll do the alerting + dashboard changes. Plan: new alert `eviction_rate_10m` -> infra-oncall page (P2). Also add a heatmap for eviction vs queue depth. PR tomorrow.
Samir: I'll validate rollback and canary checklist. Intend to add a 5-step playbook that on-call can run in 10 minutes. Also will test rollback command on a staging Dedicated cluster.
Lindsey: I'll draft fallback routing language: when Dedicated queues spike for >10m and eviction rate > threshold, route new requests to shared models and apply soft-throttling. Will include sample routing config.
Mira: Good. Please keep items one-line in the 'Postmortem followups' section of the doc so I can triage in one pass.
Tony: Posting candidate triage snippet now:
```
# quick checks for on-call
curl -s https://infra-metrics/api?m=evictions&window=15m | jq .value
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide | grep -i queue
# if evictions > 50 and queue growth > 20% -> escalate
```
Mira: Add a rollback example too — super short.
Samir: Rollback example for Dedicated: `redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to canary-2026-03-08` — tested in staging. Will add to my PR with verification steps.
Eva: On alert semantics: propose two tiers - `eviction_warning` (5m, no page, slack only) and `eviction_critical` (10m, page infra-oncall). Want to avoid noisy pages.
Lindsey: For routing config sample, I'll include a throttling recipe and a runbook note: "if fallback engaged, set throttle to 70% and monitor latency for 15m".
Tony: I'll also add an escalation matrix: on-call -> infra lead -> platform pager; include paging windows (5, 15, 30). Keep it minimal.
Mira: Can we add a recurrence detector? Something that flags identical symptom clusters within 48h so we don't re-open same postmortem.
Eva: Yes — I'll add a metric that correlates eviction spikes with deployment events and labels repeats. Tie it to a 'recurrent-incident' tag in the incident tracker.
sre-bot: Created task INC-FOLLOW-314 in JIRA for postmortem followups; linked PRs and will send reminders.
Samir: I'll create the canary test plan for fallback routing in the routing CI and share steps.
Tony: Lindsey, can you pair on the fallback wording? We should use operational language not architectural theory.
Lindsey: Sure. I'll ping you in #eng-runtime.
Mira: Action list to add to the postmortem doc (one-line each): 1) Runbook triage bullets + commands (Tony) 2) Eviction alerts + dashboard (Eva) 3) Rollback checklist & test (Samir) 4) Fallback routing policy text & config sample (Lindsey) 5) Escalation matrix (Tony) 6) Recurrence detector metric (Eva). Due: Thu EOD; verification Fri morning.
Tony: I'll open PR and add a link to the runbook edits in the postmortem doc.
Eva: Dashboard PR coming in ~6 hours.
Samir: Will report back with rollback test results and JIRA subtasks.
Mira: Thanks all. If anything slips, post here and I'll reassign. Closing thread after PR links visible. :thumbsup:
